🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector strength (9/11) alongside credit easing—HYG (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY and LQD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -1.26%) RECOVERY—plus Tech vs Financials ratio rising (XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY vs XLF (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61%) RECOVERY) indicating rotation rather than outright risk-off.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress showing signs of easing: HYG/LQD direction ↑ rising with HYG (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY. Fear tone moderating: VXX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) CORRECTION ↓ falling, while Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT) is ↑ rising with SPY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-supportive: Dollar (UUP proxy) roughly flat (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND and yield picture showing mild steepening (Yield Curve ↑ rising) with TLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY. Overall conditions neither choking risk-taking nor fully easing it.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech modestly leading: XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY ↑ rising; Financials also recovering: XLF (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61%) RECOVERY. Energy mixed/rotating: XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION ↓ falling — Style: Growth/momentum modestly leading.

5. US vs Global?
US equities in short-term bounce: SPY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY ↑ rising. EM and China also showing recovery behavior with EEM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY, while Europe/Japan ratios show relative strength versus the US.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: Small-cap/speculative flows present with IWM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -3.83%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -8.50%) RECOVERY, but crypto risk muted—IBIT (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Speculation index rising modestly, signaling selective risk-on in higher-beta pockets.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity bid led by oil and base metals: USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and CPER (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -4.45%) RECOVERY ↑ rising; gold showing short-term strength—GLD (1W: +7.18% | 1M: -8.98%) RECOVERY. Metals and ags display dispersion, consistent with rotation into cyclicals.

8. Energy Trend?
Divergent: Brent/WTI proxies elevated—BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising—while sector ETF XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION shows profit-taking rotation. Natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Broad sector participation (9/11) and recovery in credit proxies HYG/LQD (both RECOVERY) support rotation. Divergences are MINOR — VXX, XLE and several comms show 1W vs 1M mismatches but no MAJOR divergence across SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to cyclicals/materials and pockets of tech momentum—XLB/Materials (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY showing strength; reduce exposure to discretionary weakness and stressed crypto—XLY (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) ABOVE TREND and Tech XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY if momentum holds. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION and Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil/energy ETFs USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND on continued supply-risk repricing. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) CORRECTION — a sustained drop toward low-20s would signal easing. Monitor HYG (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY vs LQD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -1.26%) RECOVERY around HYG/LQD ~0.80 for credit health. Track XLK/XLF ratio (XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY vs XLF (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61%) RECOVERY) near current ~2.75 for style inflection.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, with HYG/LQD recovery and rising Tech vs Financials ratio confirming sector rotation. Materials and Tech showing relative strength while volatility/energy divergences (VXX and XLE) are the key risks to monitor.
